Elements matching CSS class selector are excluded entirely

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = '<body><div class="cookie-banner">Accept cookies</div><p>Main content</p></body>'
    options = ConversionOptions(exclude_selectors=[".cookie-banner"])
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result)

main()
```
